evidence: Validation label and changes to src/validation.cpp and src/validation.h modifying TestBlockValidity's UTXO view cache.
rationale: This PR optimizes TestBlockValidity by enabling parallel prevout fetching and avoiding main cache pollution during block template checks. As noted in the discussion, this speeds up checkBlock IPC calls frequently used by the Stratum v2 Job Declarator Server role, following up on the parallel fetching introduced in #35295.
